environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in a private subnet. The ECS task role has s3:PutObject permission on the user-profiles-prod bucket. The service is exposed via an internal ALB with no request filtering. PostgreSQL RDS instance accepts connections from the ECS security group. No input validation middleware or DTO class-validator decorators are applied. The VPC has a standard S3 gateway endpoint with a default policy (Allow * on *).

config.network: Private subnet with NAT gateway, internal ALB
config.database: PostgreSQL 15 on RDS, no row-level security
